## Validation

List the exact build, headset, runtime, or source checks performed. Clearly mark anything not tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request contains one focused change.
- [ ] Code and assets are original or properly authorized.
- [ ] No game DLLs, loader binaries, credentials, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Cleanup and existing controls still work.
- [ ] Compatibility claims are accurate.
- [ ] User-facing changes are included in `CHANGELOG.md`.
